ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict the user from editing or creating Rebate Program when in Active status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , NOT( ISNULL(PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__c ) ), NOT( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status, 'Activated') ), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Active') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot activate the Rebate Program until the Sales Agreement is Active
